title: Senior Payroll / Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter (m/w/d) - Standort Recklinghausen | Hybrides Setup
description:
Du hast Freude daran, dass Gehaltsabrechnungen pünktlich erstellt werden und über eine wachsende Unternehmensgruppe hinweg effizient, digital und rechtssicher funktionieren? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:

Senior Payroll / Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter (m/w/d) - Standort Recklinghausen | Hybrides Setup

Als Senior Payroll / Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter (m/w/d) übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle innerhalb unseres Payroll-Teams und verantwortest gemeinsam mit Laura, unserer Lead Payroll, die Entgeltabrechnung für die Arsipa Holding sowie unsere über 20 Tochtergesellschaften. Gemeinsam mit dem Payroll-Team stellst Du sicher, dass unsere Entgeltabrechnung für über 1.000 Mitarbeitende zuverlässig, gesetzeskonform und effizient durchgeführt wird und entwickelst unsere Payroll-Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Dafür brauchen wir Deine Unterstützung!


Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende, PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 48 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Payroll & Entgeltabrechnung:

    • Eigenständige Durchführung der monatlichen Entgeltabrechnung für definierte Gesellschaften innerhalb der Arsipa Gruppe mit DATEV Lohn & Gehalt.

    • Sicherstellung einer termingerechten, korrekten und gesetzeskonformen Entgeltabrechnung für die Arsipa Holding sowie unsere über 20 Tochtergesellschaften.

    • Bearbeitung lohnsteuer-, sozialversicherungs- und abrechnungsrelevanter Fragestellungen.

    • Erstellung von Bescheinigungen, Meldungen sowie weiteren payrollrelevanten Auswertungen und Unterlagen.

  • Payroll Operations & Zusammenarbeit:

    • Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende, Führungskräfte sowie unsere Kolleg:innen aus People Operations in allen payrollrelevanten Fragestellungen.

    • Kommunikation und Abstimmung mit Krankenkassen, Sozialversicherungsträgern, Behörden sowie weiteren externen Stellen.

    • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Laura, unserer Lead Payroll, sowie den Kolleg:innen innerhalb unseres Payroll- und People-Teams.

    • Unterstützung bei gesellschaftsübergreifenden Payroll-Themen innerhalb unserer Unternehmensgruppe.

  • Prozesse, Digitalisierung & Harmonisierung:

    • Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung und Harmonisierung unserer Payroll-Prozesse über die gesamte Unternehmensgruppe hinweg.

    • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Optimierungspotenzialen innerhalb bestehender Payroll-Abläufe.

    • Mitwirkung an Digitalisierungsprojekten sowie der Weiterentwicklung unserer Payroll-Systemlandschaft mit DATEV Lohn & Gehalt und Personio.

    • Unterstützung beim Aufbau skalierbarer Payroll-Strukturen innerhalb einer stark wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe.


Deine Startvoraussetzungen

  • Das bringst Du mit:

    • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der eigenständigen Entgeltabrechnung sowie fundierte Kenntnisse im Lohnsteuer-, Sozialversicherungs- und Arbeitsrecht sowie praktische Erfahrung mit DATEV Lohn & Gehalt sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Payroll-Prozessen.

    • Eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise mit einer Weiterbildung im Bereich Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung, Personalfachkaufleute oder einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation.

    • Eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein.

    • Ausgeprägte Dienstleistungsorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften und internen Fachbereichen. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch.

  • Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein:

    • Von Vorteil sind Erfahrungen mit Personio oder vergleichbaren HR-Systemen.

    • Wünschenswert sind Erfahrungen in der Harmonisierung, Standardisierung oder Digitalisierung von Payroll-Prozessen.

    • Hilfreich ist ein Verständnis für Multi-Entity-, Buy-&-Build- oder dynamisch wachsende Unternehmensstrukturen.

    • Von Vorteil sind Erfahrungen in der Zusammenarbeit mit mehreren Gesellschaften sowie unterschiedlichen internen und externen Stakeholdern.

Unsere Benefits

  • Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld: Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in einer krisensicheren und nachhaltig wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe, 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, jeweils ein halber zusätzlicher freier Tag an Heiligabend und Silvester sowie ein hybrides Setup mit einem Home-Office-Tag pro Woche. Dein Arbeitsplatz befindet sich in unserem zentral gelegenen Office in 45659 Recklinghausen.

  • Starke Teamkultur: Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Stand-ups, monatlichen All-Hands Meetings und gemeinsamen Events zur Förderung einer positiven und kollegialen Arbeitsatmosphäre.

  • Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: Aktive Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer gruppenweiten Payroll-Prozesse sowie die Möglichkeit, Digitalisierung und Harmonisierung nachhaltig voranzutreiben.

  • Payroll-Expertise im Team: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Laura, unserer Lead Payroll, einem erfahrenen Payroll-Team und unseren Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus People Operations.

title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/d)

Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech!

At Apaleo, we're revolutionizing the hospitality industry with our API-first property management platform, giving businesses the power to build a tech ecosystem that enhances both guest experiences and staff efficiency. With seamless integrations to hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, our platform simplifies operations, elevates the guest journey, and drives revenue growth.

Are you ready to make an impact? We're looking for a Sr. Product Manager Fiscal & Legal (f/m/d) to join our dynamic team and help shape the future of hospitality technology and poised to propel Apaleo into 180+ countries. Be a pivotal part of crafting a fiscal/legal framework that empowers Apaleo to swiftly become compliant in new territories!

  • Owning the end to end delivery of one or two product crews within the fiscal and legal domain, for example invoicing or taxation.

  • Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through on impact analysis so nothing falls through the cracks. 
  • Working shoulder to shoulder with engineering as a technical partner. You'll get into the detail of our API-first architecture rather than handing off a ticket and waiting. 
  • Shielding your team from noise and distractions so they can focus on what matters, whilst keeping delivery predictable. 
  • Partnering with customer success, compliance and engineering stakeholders to understand what's needed and translate it into shippable work. 
  • Helping the team move faster on new country launches, contributing to our ambition of making Apaleo compliant in many more markets over the next few years. 

 

What You'll Bring to the Team 

  • At least 3 to 4 years' experience as a Product Manager, ideally in a fast moving startup or scale up environment. 
  • A strong execution mindset. You're energised by shipping, not just planning, and you take ownership of your product area without needing to be hand held. 
  • Comfort working with technical, API-first products. You can talk architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking and understand what you're shipping in real depth. 
  • Sharp prioritisation instincts. You know how to sequence work, say no to good ideas that aren't great ones, and keep a team focused day to day.

  • Clear, confident communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 

Extra Awesome Points For 

  • Experience with fiscal, tax or legal compliance topics, for example in fintech, e-commerce or ERP systems. This is a genuine nice to have, not a requirement.

What We Offer 

  • A diverse, international team. Work alongside passionate people from all sorts of backgrounds, with a genuinely global perspective.

  • Team events that are actually fun: cocktail nights, team dinners, meetups and our legendary Oktoberfest celebrations.

  • Free public transport in Munich. Your commute, covered. 

 

How You'll Make an Impact 

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. Your work will directly shape how quickly and reliably we can bring our platform to new markets, and the systems you help build will make life easier for every property that runs on Apaleo. Intro

Back problems are the most common cause of work incapacity in Germany.

Vivira has the solution: We provide digital movement therapy via app. Always available, simple, effective, and reimbursed by health insurance. Vivira was born out of the need to treat musculoskeletal conditions as simply and effectively as possible.


Your responsibilities include

As Senior Product Manager Digital Health (m/f/d), you play a central role in developing and expanding our existing digital therapy offering. 

You drive forward how we can support patients and physicians even better in treating and reducing musculoskeletal pain. Depending on your experience and current focus, you take ownership of a central product or growth area along our patient, therapy, or practice journey – acting as the interface between medical relevance, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, and commercial success.

  • Experience in Healthcare, Digital Health, HealthTech, MedTech, Pharma, Digital Therapeutics, or Clinical Software – ideally with direct DiGA experience and knowledge of the regulatory framework (DiGA, MDR).

What to expect at Vivira

title: Qualitätsmanager (m/w/d) - Lieferantenqualität & Produktprüfung
description:
Es ist Feierabend und du verlässt das Office, happy und mit einem starken Gefühl. Dein erster Tag bei PRESCH war einfach stark 🔥

Du hast dir das Sortiment angesehen: über 500 aktive Artikel, vom Hammer bis zum Säbelsägeblatt, Lieferanten über halb Asien verteilt, Verkauf in mehr als zwanzig Länder. Und du hast sofort gesehen, wo das System noch fehlt. Nicht weil hier niemand hinschaut — sondern weil bisher niemand die Aufgabe hatte, aus einzelnen Prüfungen eine Systematik zu machen.

Genau das wird deine Aufgabe. Wir erweitern unsere Qualitätssicherung deutlich, weil wir immer mehr eigene Produkte entwickeln. Du bekommst keine fertige Struktur vorgesetzt, du entwirfst sie 💪

Und du merkst schnell: Hier wird nicht geredet, hier wird gemacht. Kurze Wege, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, Entscheidungen am selben Tag.

Aufgaben

🛠️ Du gibst frei — oder eben nicht. Vor jeder Verschiffung kommt ein Muster aus der laufenden Produktion zu dir. Du prüfst nach Maß, Werkstoff, Oberfläche und Funktion, dokumentierst das Ergebnis im Erstmusterprüfbericht und entscheidest, ob die Ware rausgeht. Ohne dein Ja bewegt sich nichts.

🛠️ Du baust die Prüfsystematik auf. Prüfvorschriften je Warengruppe und je Artikel, Stichprobenumfang und Annahmezahlen nach AQL, Freigabemuster als verbindlicher Vergleichsmaßstab, Rückverfolgbarkeit von jedem Befund zu Charge und Lieferant. Reproduzierbarkeit ist der Anspruch: Dieselbe Prüfung muss in zwei Jahren dasselbe Ergebnis liefern.

🛠️ Du prüfst nach, was tatsächlich angekommen ist. Wenn die Charge im Lager eintrifft, kommt ein Muster daraus zu dir und wird gegen das verwahrte Freigabemuster abgeglichen. Genau hier fallen die Fälle auf, in denen etwas anderes geliefert wurde als freigegeben. Denn nicht nur die erste Lieferung muss stimmen, sondern die zwanzigste auch.

🛠️ Du prüfst über das gesamte Sortiment. Handwerkzeug vom Hammer über Schraubendreher, Zangen und Schlüssel bis zu Messwerkzeug und Schutzausrüstung. Und Elektrowerkzeug-Zubehör: Bohrer, Bits, Säbelsägen-, Stichsägen- und Kreissägeblätter, Schleifmittel. Handwerkzeug beurteilst du statisch, Zubehör nur unter Last — mit definiertem Prüfwerkstoff und Abbruchkriterium, damit Standzeiten vergleichbar bleiben.

🛠️ Du machst Qualität messbar. Fehlerquoten je Lieferant, Warengruppe und Charge, Reklamations- und Rückläuferquoten je Artikel, qualitätsbezogene Lieferantenbewertung. Damit im Einkauf mit Zahlen entschieden wird und nicht mit Eindrücken.

🛠️ Du gehst Kundenfehlern auf den Grund. Reklamationen, Rückläufer und Produktbewertungen sind die schnellste Qualitätsmeldung, die wir bekommen — schneller als jeder Lieferantenbericht. Du liest sie als Befund, ordnest sie der Charge zu und schließst den Kreis zum Lieferanten.

🛠️ Du steuerst unsere externen Prüfinstitute. Wo eine Norm eine akkreditierte Prüfung verlangt — VPA, TÜV, VDE — holst du Angebote, beauftragst, verfolgst Termine und bewertest die Berichte. Du behältst den Überblick, welche Norm für welche Warengruppe gilt.

🛠️ Du richtest unsere Prüfwerkstatt ein. Prüfplätze, Messmittel, Prüfwerkstoffe, Prüfmittelverwaltung mit Kalibrierintervallen. Du entscheidest mit, mit welchem Equipment du arbeitest.

🛠️ Du arbeitest mit unserem QC-Officer in Asien zusammen. Er prüft vor Ort in den Werken, du bewertest seine Berichte und gibst die Prüfanforderungen vor. Zwei Kontrollpunkte, ein System.

Dein Impact nach 12 Monaten

🛠️ Es gibt eine Prüfsystematik, nach der auch jemand anderes prüfen könnte — mit Prüfvorschriften, AQL-Niveaus und Freigabemustern für die wichtigsten Warengruppen.

🛠️ Keine Sendung verlässt die Produktion ohne dokumentierte Freigabe. Und die Prüfung ist trotzdem kein Nadelöhr.

🛠️ Jeder Befund ist zu Charge, Lieferant und Produktionszeitraum zurückverfolgbar.

🛠️ Es gibt ein monatliches Qualitätsreporting, das im Einkauf tatsächlich benutzt wird.

🛠️ Reklamationen und Rückläufer sind messbar zurückgegangen, weil Fehler bei dir auffallen und nicht beim Kunden.

🛠️ Die Prüfwerkstatt steht, inklusive Verschleißprüfung unter Last.

Qualifikation

🛠️ Technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder Meister, oder ein technisches Studium. Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Qualitätsmanagement oder vergleichbar — die Richtung ist offener als du denkst, die Praxis zählt mehr als der Abschluss.

🛠️ Zwei bis fünf Jahre in Qualitätssicherung oder Qualitätsmanagement. Idealerweise in einem Unternehmen, das beschafft statt selbst fertigt, mit internationalen Lieferanten.

🛠️ Erstbemusterung, Prüfplanung und AQL sind für dich keine Abkürzungen, sondern Alltag. Du hast schon Erstmusterprüfberichte geschrieben und Annahmezahlen festgelegt.

🛠️ Du verstehst Werkzeug als Anwender. Du hast selbst gebohrt, gesägt und geschraubt und weißt, wie sich ein gutes Werkzeug anfühlt. Ohne das bleibt jede Beurteilung eine Zahl ohne Bedeutung.

🛠️ Reproduzierbarkeit ist dein Anspruch, nicht deine Pflicht. Du hältst fest, was du feststellst — Messwert, Bild, Bedingung, Urteil. Weil ein Befund nur dann etwas wert ist, wenn er sich in zwei Jahren noch nachvollziehen lässt.

🛠️ Du bleibst standfest. Eine Sperrung hält Ware auf, und dann wird es unbequem. Wer im Zweifel freigibt, um Ruhe zu haben, macht in dieser Rolle den teuersten Fehler.

🛠️ KI ist dein tägliches Werkzeug. Wir arbeiten damit im ganzen Unternehmen. Wenn du damit schon Auswertungen, Vorlagen oder Abläufe gebaut hast, passt du gut zu uns.

🛠️ Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Du sprichst direkt mit unseren Herstellern und liest Prüfberichte im Original.

Bonus: Erfahrung mit asiatischen Lieferanten. Erfahrung mit Messmitteln wie Messschieber, Härteprüfung oder Drehmomentprüfung. Kenntnis der Normen für Werkzeug und Elektrowerkzeug-Zubehör. Erfahrung mit Verschleiß- und Standzeitprüfungen. Erfahrung im Aufbau eines QM-Systems oder einer Prüfstelle. Und wenn du eine Prüfvorschrift oder ein Prüfkonzept mitbringst, das du selbst geschrieben hast — zeig es uns. Wir wollen sehen, wie du denkst, nicht nur was im CV steht.

Benefits

🛠️ Du baust die Funktion auf, nicht nur den Prüfplatz. Prüfsystematik, Kennzahlen, Lieferantenbewertung, Prüfwerkstatt — du entscheidest, wie Qualität bei PRESCH funktioniert. Bei weiterem Wachstum wird daraus ein eigener Bereich mit Team.

🛠️ Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Kein Konzern-Reporting, keine Zwischenebene. Du berichtest direkt und bekommst Entscheidungen am selben Tag.

🛠️ Deine Freigabe hat Gewicht. Ohne dein Ja geht keine Ware raus. Das ist Verantwortung, die man nicht in jeder Qualitätsstelle bekommt.

🛠️ Gleitzeit. Du willst Job und Familie die gleiche Zeit widmen und sehnst dich daher nach einem flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodell? Kein Problem! Wir integrieren die Arbeit in unser Leben und nicht andersherum.

🛠️ Homeoffice-Tage für die Schreibtischanteile deiner Arbeit — Auswertungen, Prüfvorschriften, Reporting. Geprüft wird vor Ort, alles andere in Absprache mit dem Team.

🛠️ Du willst dich weiterentwickeln — Qualitätsmanagement, Messtechnik, Normenwissen, Auditorenqualifikation? Alles klar, dann los! Wir legen großen Wert auf deine Weiterbildung und schaffen den finanziellen und zeitlichen Rahmen dafür.

🛠️ Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit unserem Zuschuss.

🛠️ 30 Tage Urlaub.

🛠️ Mitarbeiterrabatt auf unser komplettes Werkzeugsortiment.

🛠️ Unsere Hierarchien sind flach, der Zusammenhalt ist groß: Wir feiern unseren Erfolg. Wissensaustausch, Glühweinabende, BBQ und regelmäßige Teamevents erwarten dich bei uns. Getränke sind selbstverständlich dabei.

🛠️ Du bist in alle Geschehnisse unseres jungen und wachsenden Unternehmens einbezogen und führst deine eigenen Projekte.

Wenn du Qualitätssicherung nicht verwalten, sondern aufbauen willst — dann freuen wir uns auf dich!

description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Camunda's Revenue Operations organization is looking for a Senior GTM Systems AI and Automation Engineer to design, build and operate the AI-powered infrastructure that connects our go-to-market systems and removes manual work across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and Account Development. You will join the GTM Systems team – a small group of builders who own a Salesforce-centric revenue stack – and take ownership of its AI and automation layer: agents, LLM integrations, MCP servers, retrieval pipelines, backend services and workflow orchestration. You will partner with GTM leaders to find high-impact problems, scope them, and ship reliable, well-governed solutions iteratively. This is a fully remote role and can be based anywhere we are eligible to hire.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build and operate AI agents, LLM integrations and automations that connect Salesforce, Gainsight, Slack, Salesloft, Clari, HubSpot, Impartner and the rest of the GTM stack – reducing manual work across Sales, CS, Marketing, Partners and ADR teams.

  • Own the architecture of the GTM Systems AI layer: MCP servers, APIs, retrieval and context pipelines, reusable agent tools and skills, and serverless or containerized services on Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions).

  • Ship production-grade LLM capabilities – prompt engineering, RAG, function calling, structured outputs, automated evaluations – with the guardrails to match: validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human escalation paths, access controls, audit logging, and cost and latency management.

  • Partner with Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and SDR/ADR leaders to identify and prioritize automation opportunities, translate ambiguous requirements into maintainable solutions, and deliver incrementally with clear documentation.

  • Raise the engineering bar for the GTM Systems team: code review, automated testing, CI/CD, security governance, observability and technical documentation; mentor teammates on responsible AI-assisted development.

  • Design and deploy workflows on orchestration platforms such as Camunda and Clay, and create playbooks and enablement so GTM teams can use and operate automations independently.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience (backend development, systems integration, data or analytics engineering, or automation), including at least 2 years shipping LLM or AI capabilities into production business workflows or internal tools.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js), with mature Git-based development habits: code review, automated testing, CI/CD.

  • Hands-on command of LLM patterns – prompt engineering, RAG, function/tool calling, structured outputs, model evaluation – and of their failure modes and mitigations (validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human review, cost and latency control).

  • Experience integrating with Salesforce (REST/Bulk/Streaming APIs, data model, platform limits; Apex or Flow a plus) and other business systems via APIs and event-driven patterns, and with a cloud platform (GCP preferred: BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, IAM).

  • Ability to own a problem end-to-end with minimal guidance – scope, design, deliver, operate – and to communicate clearly with engineering and business stakeholders in a remote, asynchronous environment.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards for connecting AI systems to tools and data; agent frameworks; vector databases or retrieval pipelines (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB).

  • Exposure to AI observability and evaluation tooling (LangSmith, Weights & Biases, or custom eval frameworks).

  • Familiarity with orchestration platforms such as Camunda or Clay, and prior work in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations or Marketing Operations in B2B SaaS.

  • Building lightweight interfaces for AI tools (React, Slack Block Kit, dashboards); Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Integration Architect).

title: Senior Avionics System Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

We are looking for an Avionics Systems Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and validation of spacecraft avionics systems. The role focuses on delivering robust and reliable electronic systems for data handling, communications, and control across all mission phases.

The engineer will contribute to system architecture definition, interface management, verification activities, and requirements engineering, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. In this role, you might be assigned to different avionics systems of the spacecraft.

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture

  • Define and develop avionics system architectures, including electronics, data handling, and communication functions.

  • Ensure end-to-end consistency of data flows, interfaces, and system-level requirements.

  • Support selection and definition of avionics equipment, computing platforms, sensors, and communication hardware.

  • Contribute to spacecraft-level trade-offs between performance, reliability, mass, power, and cost.

Communications & Data Handling

  • Define onboard and ground-related communication and data handling concepts.

  • Support implementation of telemetry, telecommand, and data distribution architectures.

  • Ensure reliable data acquisition, processing, storage, and transmission under mission constraints.

  • Contribute to bandwidth, timing, and data budget analyses.

Integration & Interface Management

  • Define and manage interfaces between avionics and other spacecraft subsystems (power, propulsion, GNC, payload, etc.).

  • Ensure compatibility between spacecraft, launch vehicle, and ground segment interfaces.

  • Coordinate interface definitions with internal teams, suppliers, and external stakeholders.

External Regulatory & Certification Leadership

Strong ability to technically present, defend, and substantiate avionics subsystem designs and verification evidence with external regulatory and certification authorities, including NASA, ESA, and other government agencies, supporting spacecraft qualification, safety, and flight certification.

Verification & Validation

  • Define and support verification and validation strategies for avionics systems.

  • Participate in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level testing activities.

  • Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and drive corrective actions.

  • Ensure compliance with system performance and reliability requirements.

Requirements Engineering

  • Capture, analyze, and manage system and subsystem requirements.

  • Ensure full traceability from mission objectives to implementation and validation.

  • Contribute to system documentation, including specifications, interface control documents, and test plans.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable space standards and engineering best practices.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with software, hardware, systems, operations, and mission engineering teams.

  • Participate in design reviews, technical exchanges, and system trade-off discussions.

  • Support alignment with external partners, suppliers, and customers.

  • Contribute to integration campaigns, launch preparation, and mission operations support.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent.

  • +7 years experience in avionics systems, electronics, embedded systems, or spacecraft engineering.

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Electronic and embedded system architectures

    • Communication and data handling principles

    • System integration and interface management

  • Experience with requirements engineering and system lifecycle development.

  • Knowledge of verification and validation methods, including testing and simulation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work in multidisciplinary engineering environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in spacecraft avionics or aerospace systems.

  • Familiarity with space communication and data standards (e.g., CCSDS).

  • Experience with HIL testing, simulation environments, or digital engineering tools.

  • Exposure to safety-critical or mission-critical system development.

  • Experience working in international or multi-stakeholder engineering teams.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. title: Deployment Strategist
description:
About Atira

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.

We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!

Why Deployment Strategists are our customers' #1 go-to person

We aim to solve the most complex problems in sales engineering and work closely with customers in mapping out their ideal inbound process. You will dive into our enterprise customers processes to help deploy Atira agents with our FDEs and face their most intricate challenges. You are the go-to person inside our largest partners for anything project management and use case scoping related, and this from the point where you demo our product for the first time up until multi-annual partnership commercial negotiations.
Trust and use case insights are your two most valuable resources you get from customers and what you bring back home will directly shape our core platform in the near future - this requires a strong taste when it comes to how a software product is shaped and a strong opinion on what is needed to maximize customer satisfaction. Beyond that, our Deployment Strategists think beyond a single customer and are essential in figuring out the concrete steps to scale to our next 100 customers by accelerating onboarding processes and increasing customer satisfaction.

What you will do

  • Own the customer end-to-end together with an FDE Tech Lead. From kickoff to renewal, you are on the hook. You run SteerCos, scope deployments, drive onboarding, and decide what gets built next.

  • Scope the agents that work best for a customer You go deep on each customer's technical sales process, understanding it in all it’s details. You bring home whatever solves their problems and conceptualize this across all of your customers

title: Senior Software Engineer

Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level prostate cancer screening, ultimately improving patient outcomes worldwide.

Join our engineering team as a Full Stack Engineer and help build the next generation of medical imaging platforms. You'll work at the intersection of healthcare and technology, developing secure, scalable systems that directly impact patient care and clinical workflows.

You'll design and implement robust distributed systems that power our AI diagnostic tools—architecting services that handle sensitive medical data reliably, scale gracefully under load, and integrate seamlessly with hospital infrastructure.

  • Scalable microservices architectures using Kubernetes for orchestration and deployment

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of full-stack engineering experience with shipped products that real users depend on

  • Strong system design skills with experience architecting distributed systems and microservices

  • DevOps expertise with Kubernetes, containerization, CI/CD, and Google Cloud Platform

  • Backend proficiency in Python with Flask or FastAPI for building reliable APIs and services

  • Database expertise in SQL and relational data modeling for handling complex medical data

  • Experience with message queues and event-driven architecture patterns

  • Clear communication skills and a pragmatic approach to solving complex technical problems

Bonus Points

  • Experience in healthcare/medical software development

Your work will directly contribute to advancing cancer care technology. Every system you build, every optimization you make, and every integration you design helps medical professionals provide better care to patients facing one of life's most challenging diagnoses.

Der Legal-Tech-Markt ist über 16 Milliarden Dollar schwer und wächst jedes Jahr zweistellig. In zwei Jahren wirst du auf diesen Moment zurückblicken. 

Die Frage ist nur: Warst du dabei? 


Deine Rolle 
 

Du verantwortest ein eigenes Vertical in DACH, z.B. Financial Services, Energy, Manufacturing oder Pharma. Dein Fokus liegt auf Neukundengewinnung und gezieltem Cross-Sell in deinem bestehenden Portfolio. 

  • Du identifizierst und qualifizierst neue Opportunities, gemeinsam mit deinem BDR, über Anfragen, Marketing und gezielte Ansprache. 

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, nicht aus dem Bauch. Du baust deinen Territory Plan auf, entwickelst Account Plans für deine Top-Targets und treibst gemeinsam mit deinem BDR fokussierte Pod Sprints in deinem Vertical. 

  • Deine Deals liegen typischerweise zwischen 50.000 € und 200.000 € Jahresvolumen. Sales-Cycles dauern 4–9 Monate. Pro Deal sprichst du mit 4–7 Entscheidern: Legal, IT, Einkauf, Finance, manchmal Vorstand. 

  • Du verkaufst eine Plattform, kein Einzelprodukt. Erstgespräche führen oft Legal Ops Manager oder General Counsel. Deals über mehrere Module sind bei uns die Regel. 

  • Du repräsentierst DiliTrust auf den wichtigen Branchen-Events wie z.B. Legal Revolution oder LegalTech. Du führst dort die Gespräche, die später zu Pipeline werden. 


Must-have

  • 4+ Jahre Erfahrung im quotaverantwortlichen B2B-Software-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld. 

  • Erfahrung in komplexen Sales-Cycles mit mehreren Entscheidern aus Legal, IT, Finance oder Procurement. 

  • Methodisches Arbeiten: Du qualifizierst sauber (z. B. mit MEDDPICC) und führst belastbare Forecasts. 

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an C-Level-Entscheider. 

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachen-Niveau, sehr gutes Englisch – unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch. 


Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an Rechts-, Governance- oder Compliance-Funktionen. 

  • Du kennst die Welt regulierter Branchen - Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare oder Pharma. 

  • Du hast bereits eigenständig ein Territory aufgebaut – mit klarer Account-Strategie und nachhaltigem Pipeline-Aufbau. 

  • Du interessierst dich für KI im Unternehmenskontext  und kannst Kunden den Unterschied zwischen Hype und echtem Mehrwert erklären. 


Was wir dir bieten

  • Remote-First. Du arbeitest von zuhause oder in unseren Offices in München und Berlin - regelmäßige Team-Events bringen uns offline zusammen. 

  • Onboarding und Ramp-Up, das zu einem komplexen Produkt passt. Produkt, Branche und Methodik step by step - mit erfahrenen Teamkollegen, die dich auf Tempo bringen. 

  • Ehrliches Coaching, präsenter Sales Manager. Wir sind 7 Leute im DACH-Sales, keine Nummer in einer großen Maschine. Regelmäßige Einzelgespräche, gemeinsame Deal-Reviews. Wenn du gut bist, wird das gesehen. Wenn etwas hakt, wird darüber gesprochen. 

  • Karriereperspektive in einer Wachstumsregion. Senior AE, Enterprise AE, Team Lead DACH: wir bauen die Region aktiv aus, nicht ab. 

  • Internationales Setup, lokaler Fokus. Dein Spielfeld ist DACH, aber wenn dich die Lust auf Mailand, Madrid oder Mexico City packt, kannst du auch von dort arbeiten. 

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, Zulage für Heimarbeit und weitere Vorteile folgen in Kürze! 


Dein Weg zu uns

  1. Erstgespräch mit dem Recruiting-Team (30 Min, auf Englisch) – wir lernen uns kennen, klären gegenseitige Erwartungen. 

  1. Interview mit dem Sales Manager DACH (45 Min) – Deep Dive in deine Erfahrung, deine Methodik und Fit für die Rolle. 

  1. Interview mit dem Global Chief Sales Officer (45 Min) – Strategie, Karriereperspektive, Final-Check. 

  1. Kurzes Rollenspiel (45 Min) – eine realistische Sales-Situation, an der wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Du bekommst Briefing und Vorbereitungszeit. 

Bist du bereit, bei uns einzusteigen?

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – wenn möglich auf Englisch – ein Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Wenn du vorab Fragen hast: ----- oder sende eine LinkedIn-Nachricht an Fabian Pohl.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung.

Hinweis: Wir nutzen KI-gestützte Tools zur Vorauswahl von Bewerbungen. Die endgültige Entscheidung trifft immer ein Mensch.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
Sales Development Representative

Edinburgh

 

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The Role

We’re hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to spearhead our outbound engine and book high-quality opportunities with in-house legal teams.

This is the frontline of our growth. You’ll be responsible for finding the right accounts, crafting compelling outreach, and breaking into companies. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our Account Executives (AEs) and Marketing teams to build a predictable pipeline.

This is an early-stage environment. Things move fast, priorities shift, and there isn’t always a clear playbook. You’ll need to be resilient, highly organized, and willing to experiment with new ways to get a prospect’s attention.

What you’ll do

  • Build and execute targeted outbound campaigns (email, cold calling, LinkedIn) to general counsel and legal leaders.

  • Consistently hit and exceed monthly meeting-booked and pipeline targets.

  • Partner closely with AEs to strategize on key accounts and ensure smooth handoffs.

  • Act as a feedback loop for Marketing and Product by tracking what messaging resonates most with the market.

  • Maintain meticulous CRM data — keeping track of accounts, prospects, and outreach activity.

What we’re looking for

  • SaaS sales or lead generation experience (experience selling to legal, finance, or compliance is a major plus, but not required).

  • A relentless work ethic — you aren't afraid of the phone and view "no" as data, not a deterrent.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can cut through the noise with clear, value-led messaging.

  • High curiosity and coachability; you want to master the product, the market, and the art of sales.

  • High ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, not just logging activities.

  • Organized, consistent, and reliable with excellent time management.

How we work

We’re an in-office team. We work together because it makes us faster, sharper, and more effective. You should expect to be in the office our out visiting clients as your default.

This is a high performance environment. We set a high bar, move quickly, and expect people to take ownership of real problems.

There isn’t always a clear path. The people who do well here figure things out, stay close to the work, and keep pushing until they get to the right outcome.

This role requires patience, structure, and strong judgement. You’ll be trusted to run complex deals with a high degree of autonomy.

 

Why Wordsmith

We’re in a period of strong momentum — growing quickly, winning new customers, and expanding into larger accounts.

The product is landing well, the market is ready, and the team is scaling to meet demand.

If you want to be in the room, close meaningful deals, and grow quickly in a high bar environment, this is one of the best places to do it.

description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Accountant / Financial Reporting specialist to join our Finance Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help strengthen core accounting execution, audit management, and monthly consolidated results analysis while being part of a high-growth environment as we scale our financial infrastructure. If you're excited about leveraging AI and automation to redefine modern accounting with a strong focus on IFRS excellence and financial rigor, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Accounting Associate Director and work closely with teams across the Finance organisation. You will be part of a team dedicated to technical rigor and operational efficiency, partnering with cross-functional departments to elevate our accounting processes to the next level.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Accountant, you will:

  • Prepare and post journal entries, perform balance sheet reconciliations, and drive high standards for period close improving quality and speed.

  • Own the preparation of audit schedules, coordinate responses to requests, and drive the closure of audit questions to ensure a predictable, well-documented process.

  • Deep dive into monthly results, flagging risks, unusual transactions, and key movements while providing decision-ready insights for finance leadership.

  • Identify accounting risks, implement practical mitigations, and strengthen internal controls to ensure our processes are scalable and accurate.

  • Actively leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and consistency, identifying opportunities to standardise and simplify recurring accounting work.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 6+ years of experience with a strong ability to apply IFRS in real-world scenarios.

  • Comfort working with consolidated results, analysing variances, and exercising complex accounting estimates and judgments.

  • Proven experience managing audits end-to-end or acting as the primary finance contact for external auditors.

  • A track record (or clear potential) of using AI and automation to improve accounting outcomes and efficiency.

  • The ability to operate effectively in a fast-changing environment with an "ownership mindset" and excellent judgment.

  • Strong ability to translate complex accounting issues into scalable process improvements and clear insights for stakeholders.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want genuine agency at group level rather than executing instructions handed down by a central team

  • You'd rather design a process than inherit one, and you want to see your own work implemented

  • You like variety. This is a different topic most days, not a fixed monthly cycle

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You want a settled, mature environment where the process is set and the day looks the same. That's the clearest reason this role doesn't work out for people

  • You need stable priorities. It's volatile here. Several topics run at once, progress depends on other people, and priorities can change overnight

  • You want to stay inside accounting. A large part of the job is working with teams outside Finance and with external advisors in each country

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 - 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the Audit Readiness initiative to drive impact in our year-end execution and documentation standards.

  • Collaborate with the Finance team to embed AI-forward ways of working, automating manual workflows to increase team capacity.

  • Grow your skills in process improvements and financial analysis, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale across our legal entity markets.

  • We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger leadership projects, mastering the intersection of AI and Finance, or deepening your expertise in complex consolidated reporting.

The location

This role is hybrid (on average, 3 days a week in the office) and can be located in either our Lisbon or Madrid office.

Show me the benefits!

💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  • Hiring manager interview: A conversation with our Accounting Associate Director covering your technical accounting and IFRS experience.

  • Team panel and Pleo challenge: You'll meet the hiring manager, his manager and a peer from the team. The challenge is presented live in the session, so there's nothing to prepare or send in advance. We're looking at how you handle complexity, new areas and stakeholders.

  • Final interview: A closing conversation, used where it's helpful for both sides.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired this role, we received a lot of applications but can only interview a finite number of people. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD)
description:
Tired of retail pharmacy?

Imagine working in a modern, technology-enabled online pharmacy where you can focus on accuracy, quality and patient safety—without standing behind a retail counter, selling OTC products or being interrupted every few minutes.

That's what we're building at Montu.

You will be a central, trusted part of our pharmacy operation at our Winnersh site — the person the team relies on to make sure every medicine that leaves our pharmacy is right.

As an Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD), you will be responsible for carrying out the final accuracy check on dispensed prescriptions before they are supplied to patients. You will act as an independent safeguard within the dispensing process, ensuring that medicines are assembled exactly as prescribed and in line with legal, operational and patient safety standards.

Getting it right the first time is non-negotiable. You will be trusted to exercise professional judgement, identify risks before they become incidents, and have the confidence to stop the process whenever something does not look right.

What will you be doing?

  • Carrying out the final accuracy check on dispensed medicines, confirming that the product supplied matches the prescription and accompanying documentation.

  • Verifying the right patient, right medicine, right strength, right formulation, right quantity and right directions, ensuring all labelling is accurate and appropriate.

  • Checking that medicines have been assembled in accordance with legal requirements, SOPs and company processes.

  • Identifying and escalating discrepancies, near misses and potential dispensing errors immediately, supporting a culture of openness and continuous improvement.

  • Maintaining clear, accurate and auditable records of all checks completed.

  • Exercising professional judgement and recognising when concerns fall outside your scope of practice, referring to the Responsible Pharmacist where appropriate.

  • Supporting the safe handling and checking of controlled drugs, unlicensed medicines and high-risk medications, in accordance with relevant legislation and internal procedures.

  • Ensuring appropriate expiry date checks, batch number verification (where applicable), and packaging integrity checks are completed before supply.

  • Working closely with dispensers, pharmacists and the wider pharmacy team to resolve queries efficiently while maintaining independence during the final checking process.

  • Contributing to quality assurance initiatives, investigations and process improvements aimed at reducing dispensing errors and improving patient safety.

  • Supporting and mentoring colleagues, helping to embed a culture of accountability, quality and attention to detail.

  • Remaining up to date with SOPs, regulatory requirements and best practice guidance to maintain competence and ensure the highest standards of checking.

What do you need?

  • An accredited Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD) qualification recognised for pharmacy dispensing practice.

  • Significant experience working within a pharmacy environment with a proven track record of conducting final accuracy checks.

  • A detailed understanding of the dispensing process and the critical control points that prevent medication errors.

  • Strong knowledge of pharmacy legislation, SOPs, governance requirements and patient safety principles.

  • The ability to work independently and make sound decisions while recognising the limits of your competence and escalating concerns appropriately.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain concentration and accuracy, even when working at pace.

  • Confidence to challenge discrepancies and halt the supply process when patient safety could be compromised.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • A proactive mindset, taking ownership of issues and following them through to resolution.

  • A genuine commitment to patient outcomes — understanding that every prescription represents a person relying on you to get it right.

title: Senior Manager - Incentives
description:
This role sits within the Onboarding & Incentives pillar of the Rider Growth function at Deliveroo, this pillar owns the journey from the moment an applicant expresses interest through to a fully habituated, retained rider. We collaborate closely with Product, Data Science, Regional Operations, Rider Marketing and the Retention team to secure and retain a high-quality fleet.

We are seeking a Senior Manager to own three of the core engines behind our rider supply strategy: incentives, performance tracking, and target setting with scope to own wider areas of responsibility as these solutions are productionised.

  1. You will have overall accountability of our rider referral program from strategy to execution. You’ll partner closely with the Retention & Resurrection team on retention incentives, ensuring incentive spend across the rider lifecycle is efficient, well-targeted, and joined up. As part of this, you’ll design the governance frameworks needed to ensure all incentives across referrals, retention, resurrection and activation are operating efficiently and tests are designed robustly.

  2. You will also own performance tracking of rider hours end-to-end, partnering with teams across acquisition, conversion, activation, and retention to understand the forecast and actuals behind their initiatives, and working with Data Science to attribute causality to that work – giving senior stakeholders an accurate, defensible read on how our supply investments are performing.

  3. Finally, you will own our rider applicant target-setting model which is used to determine our rider acquisition forecasts vs top-down targets, working with Science and local Regional Operations teams. Improvements here will ensure we’re able to plan for longer time horizons with greater degrees of accuracy as well as scenario planning with our Rider Marketing team to drive efficiencies in cost per applicant.

What we’re looking for

  • Analytical Rigor: You are highly comfortable building and defending forecasting, target-setting, and attribution models, and can translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Ownership & Follow-Through: You take full accountability for the incentives and reporting you own, proactively flagging risks to plan and driving fixes end-to-end.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: You work effectively across Data Science, Regional Operations, Retention & Resurrection, and Rider Marketing to align on shared goals and targets.

  • Stakeholder Communication: You can distil complex performance and target-setting narratives into clear, credible updates for senior stakeholders.

What you'll be doing

  • Referral & Reactivation Incentives: Own the end-to-end strategy, performance, and budget for rider referral and reactivation incentive programmes, continuously testing and iterating to improve efficiency.

  • Retention Incentive Partnership: Partner closely with the Retention & Resurrection team on retention incentives, ensuring a joined-up approach to incentive spend across the rider lifecycle.

  • Rider Hours Performance Tracking: Own tracking of rider hours performance, partnering with teams across acquisition, conversion, activation, and retention to understand the forecast and actuals behind their initiatives.

  • Causal Attribution: Partner with Data Science to attribute causality to individual initiatives’ contribution to rider hours, building a robust and defensible measurement framework.

  • Senior Stakeholder Reporting: Ensure rider hours performance and initiative impact are reported accurately and clearly to senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

  • Weekly Applicant Target Setting: Own the weekly rider applicant target-setting process, ensuring targets reflect the latest view of demand, funnel performance, and onboarding capacity.

  • Annual Planning: Lead applicant target setting within the annual planning cycle, working with Science and local Regional Operations teams to work back from onboard targets to applicant targets.

  • Scenario Planning & Cost Efficiency: Run scenario planning with the Rider Marketing team to stress-test target and budget assumptions and identify opportunities to drive down cost per applicant.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Build strong working relationships across Science, Regional Operations, Retention & Resurrection, and Rider Marketing to keep incentive, performance, and target-setting decisions aligned.

Requirements

  • Experience in Operations, Strategy & Operations, or Growth/Performance Marketing, ideally within a high-growth marketplace or on-demand business.

  • Proven experience owning incentive programmes or performance-based spend, including budget management and ROI measurement.

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with experience in forecasting, target setting, and/or causal measurement.

title: Strategy & Operations Manager, Subscription Value Prop & New Benefits
description:
About the team

The Value Proposition & New Benefits team owns what our core value proposition for subscription should be, and the new benefits that bring it to life. We sit within the wider Subscription EMEA org, whose vision is to create the world's leading membership programme in local commerce, delivering unprecedented value and a world-class experience to members.

About the role

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to own strategy and execution for new benefits within Subscription. This is a hybrid strategy/build/run role: you'll define what to launch, then work cross-functionally to get it shipped and measure whether it's working. You'll be expected to move fluidly between strategic thinking and hands-on execution - this is not a role where strategy stops at a slide deck.

Typical problems you'll solve:

  • What new benefits should we launch for Subscription - which ideas are worth pursuing, and what's the business case for each?

  • How do we prioritise and sequence a pipeline of benefit ideas against limited engineering, design, and operational capacity?

  • How do we define success for a new benefit before launch - what does a good outcome look like, and what would tell us to kill it?

  • Once live, how is a benefit actually performing - impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and member satisfaction - against its cost to serve, and what does that tell us to do next?

  • How do we take a benefit from a small pilot to a scaled, steady-state feature, and what needs to be true operationally for that to work?

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we’re hiring

  • We're post-PMF and revenue generating, launching in the US ahead of a Series A. Early enough that you'll shape how engineering works here, late enough that you're not gambling on whether the product works.

  • You'll own significant parts of the product and ship the things customers feel most. It's a regulated platform moving money across multiple jurisdictions, so the work has to be right and it still has to be fast.

  • We also want the bar to move while you're here. Senior engineers set the standard through the quality of what they ship, how they review, and the problems they choose to fix rather than work around.

  • Alongside that, we're rethinking how we build with AI. We use the tools, but we know there's a step change available to teams who redesign their whole workflow around them rather than adding AI to how they already work. If you've already done that somewhere else, you'll have a lot of room here.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and run non-trivial production systems, and you've learned what works in which situations rather than defaulting to one approach.

  • Strong architectural judgement. Most of our code is now written by an LLM, which means you need to own the decisions around it: how the system is structured, what the patterns are, whether the thing being built is the right thing at all. Our stack is Go, and if you learn quickly, not having written it isn't a problem.

  • A serious AI practice. You can talk specifically about how AI has changed the way you build, what it's actually made faster, and what you've shared with the teams you've worked in.

  • Directness. You give feedback when something isn't good enough and take it just as well.

  • Good instincts about what's worth doing. You know when something needs to be built properly and when it doesn't, and you push for the work that makes everyone around you faster.

Probably not for you if

You think the impact of AI on engineering is overstated. You'd rather be handed a fully specified ticket than question the brief. Or the learning curve across finance, compliance and multiple jurisdictions sounds like a chore rather than the interesting part.

The people who do well here find that last bit genuinely interesting. Understanding how capital actually moves, and what the rules allow in each jurisdiction, is most of what makes this product hard to build and hard to copy.

The hiring process

Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one.

  1. Call with Imani, our Head of People and Talent. You'll get a proper picture of the role and the company, and we'll get into how you work and how you build.

  2. System design session with our engineering team. No leetcode and no take-home. We want to see how you approach a problem and structure a solution.

  3. Paid trial day. A real Odin problem with everything you need handed to you. You see how we work, we see how you ship.

Working at Odin

Two setups work for this role: London hybrid (three days a week in the office) or remote from elsewhere in Europe with quarterly trips to London.

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en Evaluation de la vulnérabilité d’un réseau d’accès Télécom de type PON (Passive Optical Network) vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensor) - CDD de 12 mois
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 5 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en évaluation de la vulnérabilité d’un réseau d’accès Télécom de type PON (Passive Optical Network) vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensor) pour rejoindre le département Communications et Electronique (COMELEC).

Cette étude se situe dans le cadre du projet « Ecoute Acoustique Terrestre » (EAT) RAPID (Régime d’Appui Pour l’Innovation Duale), fruit d’un partenariat entre la société Febus Optics et Télécom Paris.

 La mesure de vibrations acoustiques distribuées par fibre optique (DAS, Distributed Acoustic Sensing) est une technologie récente, dont les applications ne cessent de se diversifier. On peut citer par exemple la détection d’intrusion en surveillance périmétrique, les mesures sismiques, le diagnostic de puits (pétrole, géothermie), etc. La bande passante de la mesure, de sub-Hertz à la centaine de kiloHertz, permet également d’envisager la captation de la bande audio, et donc de réaliser des mesures audios sur une fibre optique. Il est ainsi possible d’utiliser le réseau optique télécom d’un bâtiment pour réaliser des écoutes, en utilisant un système DAS modifié, intégrant des artéfacts matériels particuliers (enroulement, antennes, connecteurs) au voisinage de la zone d’écoute et un traitement du signal spécifique pour obtenir des performances suffisantes.

Le cadre de ce Postdoc est d’évaluer la vulnérabilité d’un réseau télécom vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS. Le branchement sur un réseau optique Telecom local en fonctionnement nécessite de s’adapter à son architecture, notamment en termes de plan de longueur d’onde.

L’audit des systèmes de télécommunication afin d’en évaluer la vulnérabilité constitue un enjeu majeur du réseau télécom. Un exemple de configuration d’un réseau d’accès est décrit dans la figure ci-après. Depuis le réseau Backbone, à partir du ‘Central Office’, les signaux télécoms sont acheminés chez les abonnés via le PON (Passive Optical Network). À l’intérieur des bâtiments, un réseau FTTX (Fiber To The X=H home, X=R room, X=O office, etc) ou un réseau local LAN (Local Area Network) optique servent respectivement à acheminer le signal optique jusqu’au terminal final ou à communiquer entre deux terminaux locaux via une liaison optique. Le PON comprend une fibre nourricière (Feeder Fiber) puis, au moins, un coupleur 1×N. Le codage de l’information est alors un mélange de multiplexage en longueur d’onde grossier (C-WDM) et de multiplexage temporel (TDM). Chaque voie de sortie du coupleur 1×N est envoyée vers des groupes de 1 à n abonnés à travers, au moins, un filtre qui sélectionne la longueur d’onde qui leur est allouée. Le signal après ce filtre est alors monochromatique et codé TDM. Le dernier coupleur 1×n répartie le signal chez les n abonnés. Ce PON comprend donc, entre autres, des coupleurs passifs qui divisent les signaux vers différents abonnés mais aussi des connecteurs, soudures, etc.

L’objectif de ce Postdoc est de faire un état des lieux des différents types de réseau mis en place et d’en évaluer les conséquences sur la capacité de mesures DAS :

·         Description des différents types de réseaux locaux existants,

·         Etats des lieux des différents types de transmission : CWDM, TDM, …

·         Quels sont les différents points d’accès pour une mesure DAS ?

·         Comment discriminer les différentes fibres interrogées après un coupleur ? Influence des points réflecteurs,

·         Etude des différentes marges de puissance pour une mesure DAS,

·         Potentielle présence de nœuds d’insertion et limite de la transparence optique,

·         Sensibilité des mesures DAS en fonction des différents types de fibre et de leur environnement,

·         Influence du réflecteur final sur la capacité d’écoute.

Le caractère innovant sera la définition des conditions du réseau et des configurations et des performances DAS permettant un audit cyber sur des infrastructures déjà déployées.

Au-delà d’une synthèse des configurations que l’on peut trouver sur le terrain, il s’agira de mener des tests, soit sur un réseau réel auxquels un accès nous sera donné, soit sur un réseau modèle implémenté pour l’étude. Ces travaux permettront d’identifier le type de modules d’interfaçage nécessaires, et de les spécifier, puis de les concevoir et de les fabriquer.

Vos principales missions seront :

  • Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine des capteurs à fibre optique distribués

  • Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat

  • Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris


Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat en génie électrique, en communications optiques, en photonique, en capteurs optiques ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez d’une solide expertise théorique et pratique en photonique et en traitement du signal numérique, ainsi que de bonnes compétences en programmation. Une connaissance des algorithmes de traitement du signal appliqués aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique, notamment dans le cadre de la détection cohérente, constitue un atout. Vous maîtrisez l’anglais, et la pratique du français est souhaitée.

Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes capable d’évoluer dans un environnement multiculturel. Vous êtes à l’aise pour encadrer des stagiaires ou des étudiants dans le cadre de projets. Enfin, vous faites preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de qualités relationnelles, rédactionnelles et pédagogiques, ainsi que d’une excellente capacité d’analyse et de synthèse.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers, navette mutualisée en partance de la Porte d'Orléans). Vous bénéficierez de :

  1.      Contexte général

IMT Nord Europe est une des plus importantes Ecole d’Ingénieurs au nord de Paris. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

École sous tutelle du ministère en charge de l’économie et des finances, et école de l’Institut Mines Télécom, IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les domaines[1] suivants :

·         Sciences et Technologies du Numérique

·         Processus pour l’Industrie et les Services

·         Énergie et Environnement

·         Matériaux et Procédés avancés appliqués aux polymères, composites et génie civil.

Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre d’Enseignement, de Recherche et d’Innovation Énergie Environnement (CERI EE). Le (la) candidat(e) intégrera l’axe thématique Energie, Fluides et Transferts qui développe des activités de recherche sur l’intensification des phénomènes de transfert dans les composants thermo-fluidiques, le stockage de l’énergie thermique et les fluides complexes, appliqués dans le domaine du génie des procédés et de l’énergétique, à des fins de décarbonation de la société notamment.  Le projet REVEST bénéficie du soutien de la Région Hauts-de-France et est labellisé par plusieurs pôles de compétitivité. Il offre un environnement de recherche associant développement expérimental, excellence scientifique et valorisation technologique, en lien étroit avec les acteurs régionaux de l'innovation.


[1] Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’Ecole : https://imt-nord-europe.fr/

  1.      Projet scientifique

1.1.                       Contexte

Le projet REVEST s'inscrit dans la continuité des travaux menés dans le cadre de la thèse de doctorat réalisée au laboratoire et du projet INNO-REV[1]. Il vise à développer et valider de nouvelles solutions passives permettant d'améliorer les performances d’unité de stockage thermique par chaleur latent au sein de matérieux Matériaux à Changement de Phase (MCP). Le projet s'appuie sur une installation expérimentale haute température innovante, conçue au cours de la thèse et aujourd'hui en phase finale de développement. Cette plateforme constituera un outil de référence pour caractériser les performances de nouvelles géométries d'intensification passive, produire des données expérimentales de haute qualité et valider les modèles numériques développés au laboratoire.

Le (la) postdoctorant(e) rejoindra une équipe de recherche développant une plateforme expérimentale unique à l'échelle régionale, dont il (elle) assurera la mise au point finale. Sa mission consistera à compléter son instrumentation et son système d'acquisition, puis à conduire les campagnes d'essais destinées à caractériser les performances de différentes solutions d'intensification passive des transferts thermiques. Il (elle) analysera les résultats expérimentaux, les confrontera aux modèles numériques développés au laboratoire et contribuera à l'optimisation des géométries étudiées. Il (elle) participera enfin à la diffusion des résultats scientifiques (publications et conférences internationales) ainsi qu'aux actions de valorisation et de transfert technologique menées avec les structures de valorisation du laboratoire.

Le poste convient à un(e) candidat(e) titulaire d'un doctorat en énergétique, thermique, mécanique des fluides ou discipline connexe. Les principales compétences recherchées sont les suivantes :

  • Capacité à conduire un projet de recherche de manière autonome et à travailler en équipe

La connaissance d'outils de simulation numérique (CFD ou modélisation thermique) constituera un atout, sans être un prérequis. Une expérience dans les domaines des échangeurs de chaleur, du stockage thermique, des matériaux à changement de phase ou de l'instrumentation thermique sera appréciée.

description:

Contexte

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France.
